purpose: S2 measured-reference check. The phone hour grid puts the internal zero at first-frame +3836.7 ms on full-06 and +3831.4 ms on full-04; the released anchor is at +3836.0 and +3879.6 ms respectively. The configured schedule origins precede those fires by 1400.2 and 1443.6 ms. For each trace night, compare control, zero-only, schedule-phase-only (deltaMs negative delays the schedule), and the joint measured correction. dropMs starts a freshly rebuilt office update clock at the first captured frame at or after the fitted zero. These are exact measured candidates, not a fitted search; the result stays MODEL_ONLY.
modelOptionsNote: the options the retained control result ran under (its method.modelOptionsSha256 b7eddb6025147181a8f837ed15e013925809c03d37d9f9b8aa358984daad44a4)

control.rule: at deltaMs 0, timerRate 0 and dropMs 0 each night's model window string must equal the retained variant's windows.model byte for byte

grid.timerRateRule: rate 0 only. deltaMs -L delays every scheduled send by L ms; dropMs starts the rebuilt trace clock at the first sampled frame at or after that offset. The control, each one-axis correction and their joint measured correction are retained for both trace nights.

refine.rule: No local search: the four cells per night are the predeclared control and measured corrections.

verdict.matchRule: a cell matches when unplayed = 0, compared >= matchMinCompared and agree = compared: every phone-read window the model played agrees
verdict.improveRule: a night improves when its best cell's agreeing windows (count) reach the control's plus ceil(improveMargin x the control's compared windows); a cell that dies early and agrees on a bare majority of the few windows it played does not improve anything
verdict.consistencyRule: matching cells across nights are consistent when every pair's deltaMs, timerRate and dropMs differ by at most their configured margins
verdict.statusRule: ALIGNMENT_CELLS_FOUND if any measured-reference cell matches; IMPROVED_NOT_ALIGNED if none matches but some night improves; NO_PHASE_RATE_ALIGNMENT otherwise. No status promotes MODEL_ONLY results to trace-equivalence.
